note: Simulated at Polymarket prices; no money placed. Units only.

edge.label: Value
edge.rule: Bets when the 40/60 model-market blend clears a 4-point edge and model and market differ by 30 points or less; bets more when the blended edge is bigger

agree.label: Agreement
agree.rule: Bets the model's pick when the market also makes it the favourite and the price is no worse than the model's chance and the two differ by 30 points or less; bets more when the model's edge is bigger

model_value.label: Model value
model_value.rule: Bets the model's pick when the price is below the model's chance, whichever team the market favours, if model and market differ by 30 points or less; bets more when the model's edge is bigger

favourite.label: Market favourite (control)
favourite.rule: Bets the market favourite at a flat 1 unit; the control the others must beat
